dogecoin.text: @zackvoell Dogecoin was created as a joke, but at least it's "joke money" that runs on its own network. I don't even understand what Shiba does. Is it supposed to work like money? On Ethereum network? What problem does it solve? "Run by the community"? Bitcoin and monero are ran by who?

All this talk about the shibacoin and the dogecoin remind me of when people were going heavy on shit like dash, pivx and the biggest garbage of all: verge and its killer wraith protocol!
Careful, y'all might get burnt like the kids from back in the day...
